prompt.text:
Implement linear interpolation over ordered daily observations in package `solution` with this exact API:

`type Observation struct { Minute int; Value float64 }`
`func InterpolateObservation([]Observation, int) (float64, error)`

An observation minute must be in the inclusive range 0 through 1439, and every value must be finite (neither NaN nor positive or negative infinity). At least two observations are required. Input observations must be strictly ordered by minute with no duplicates. The requested minute must also be in 0 through 1439 and must lie between the first and last observations, inclusive.

Return an exact stored value when the requested minute matches an observation. Otherwise, linearly interpolate between its two surrounding observations. Validate the complete input even if an exact match appears early. Do not reorder, mutate, or retain the input slice. On any invalid input, return zero and a non-nil error. Return one complete source file.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
